parts:
Thanks Matthew, and I hear you. Some days one wishes for data from a more controlled environment, like a lab! :-)

Sharon

On Wednesday, November 14, 2012 11:10:22 AM UTC-7, Sharon wrote:
Hello,

I am working an analysis using pCountOpen. For many models am getting very large (unreasonable large) parameter estimates for models that converge. This is happening across multiple species.

Below are the models I am running. I observe this phenomenon with both the simpler and more complex models.

The start value of "1" is in the general ballpark of what we get for parameter estimates for the models that do converge (actually, something closer to less than 1 is what we see). But we are using this default of "1" to avoid the need to run all models w/o se's to get start values and then manually plug in all of those start values into all models for all species (I don't know how to automate that process).

Any thoughts would be much appreciated!

THanks,
Sharon
